text.brief: On May 4, 1919, about three thousand students marched from their campuses to Tiananmen to protest the award of Shandong to Japan at Paris.
text.record: Woodrow Wilson agreed at the end of April 1919 to let Japan keep the German rights in Shandong ([FRUS, Paris Peace Conference 1919, Vol. V, Document 32: meeting of April 30, 1919](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1919Parisv05/d32)). The Republic of China's delegates refused to sign the Treaty of Versailles that June ([FRUS, Paris Peace Conference 1919, Vol. VI, Document 75](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1919Parisv06/d75); [FRUS 1919, Vol. I, Document 344](https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1919v01/d344)). Soviet Russia's Karakhan Manifesto of July 1919 offered to give up Tsarist privileges in China, and the offer reached Chinese readers in March 1920.
text.reading: Wilson's principles raised a hope, his bargain broke it, and the Leninist offer arrived in the gap it left. The Party dates its own origins to the May Fourth Movement, a birth in the disappointment the defenders caused.
text.gapText: Architecture Principles. The defenders proclaimed self-determination and then traded a Chinese province to hold a coalition together.
text.fix: Apply stated principles evenly or say plainly where they stop, because an adversary recruits in the gap between the two.
